title: Extract an MVC base view for explicitly requested 2D playback

definition.title: Extract an MVC base view for explicitly requested 2D playback
definition.source_excerpt: Class: Existing-file route and packet-copy construction. Output contract: The declared MVC base view, with its original decoded pictures and timing; not a stereoscopic presentation and not an arbitrary selected dependent view. Related: R29's compatible-core principle, but applied to MVC video. H.264 Multiview Video Coding provides an AVC-compatible base view. Fraunhofer HHI describes its base-view syntax and its compatibility with ordinary H.264 decoders [S1]. Investigate extracting that view into ordinary AVC access units, constructing truthful decoder initialization and container timing, and using a qualified browser decoding destination. Proposed path: MVC parsing -> qualified base-view access units -> AVC configuration and optional fragmented MP4 -> browser playback.
